metricDefinition.leadMs: (fieldMediaTime - video.currentTime) * 1000 at direct canvas draw; positive means the field content is ahead of the media element clock
metricDefinition.fieldMediaTime: requestVideoFrameCallback metadata.mediaTime for the first YADIF field; metadata.mediaTime plus half-frame media duration for the second field
metricDefinition.retirementAffected: the queued field survived at least one capacity retirement before it was drawn
